question: Which guess about Contribution Profit is most worth testing first?

sources: Deloitte Digital for Google — Milliseconds Make Millions (web.dev case study) (2020) https://web.dev/case-studies/milliseconds-make-millions
Think with Google — page load time statistics (2017) https://www.thinkwithgoogle.com/data/page-load-time-statistics

decision: Test Page Load Speed (s) → Product View Rate first: its declared range blurs the planned outcome most per unit of test cost (5.5× the next guess). This ranks what to learn, not what to do.
caveat: This interval is the uncertainty in your GUESS, not evidence. A distribution looks like data and is not. Its only purpose is to help you decide what to test, never to estimate impact.
